issues.explanation: The adaptation says 于诠 leads 朱异 and other Wu troops into Shouchun, but then says 朱异 returns to Sun Lin and is executed. In the source, 朱异 remains with the Wu army at 安丰; 于诠 leads 全懌、全端、文钦 and others into the city, while 朱异 is later executed after the failed attack.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace “于诠率朱异等一万吴兵由南门入城” with wording naming 全懌、全端、文钦等, leaving 朱异 with the outside Wu army until his later execution.
